demo: invariant -> Nemotron proposal -> Decision verdict -> Effect in containment
transport: live Token Factory call (proposal file, same endpoint)

invariants.name: destructive_filesystem_delete
invariants.intent: Recursive forced deletion of an owner-named target must never run silently: the direct form is forbidden at the Decision layer, and every spelling variant must at least surface as an explicit unknown, never as an allow.

invariants.name: production_deploy_gate
invariants.intent: A production deploy must require human approval before running: the deploy command in its production environment form prompts (or is forbidden), and no spelling variant may run silently.

invariants.name: protected_path_subtree
invariants.intent: Nothing under an owner-declared protected path may be deleted, truncated, or overwritten: the exact bound form is forbidden, and the template forces the owner to confront the token-prefix trap below.

prompt:
You propose adversarial test scenarios for a security-policy conformance tester. You do NOT judge them: a deterministic checker will decide each one. Output JSON ONLY, no prose, no markdown fences, matching this schema exactly:
{"scenarios": [{"scenario_id": "string", "invariant_id": "string", "title": "string", "argv": ["string", "..."], "rationale": "string", "expected_decision": "allow|prompt|forbidden|unknown"}]}

Rules:
- Exactly 2 scenarios per invariant, each with a unique scenario_id.
- argv is a command token array (never a shell string, never a compound command with ;, &&, or |).
- Targets must be throwaway paths under /tmp/fineprint-nemotron-demo/ ONLY, or the deployctl release form. Never target a real home, system, or credential path.
- Each variant must differ from the invariant's direct form: a flag-spelling variant, a path-form variant, or a wrapper form (e.g. a shell/env wrapper around the payload).
- expected_decision is your prediction only; the checker verdict is authoritative and may disagree.

Invariants:
- FP-001 (destructive_filesystem_delete): Recursive forced deletion of an owner-named target must never run silently: the direct form is forbidden at the Decision layer, and every spelling variant must at least surface as an explicit unknown, never as an allow. Expected decisions: forbidden.
- FP-002 (production_deploy_gate): A production deploy must require human approval before running: the deploy command in its production environment form prompts (or is forbidden), and no spelling variant may run silently. Expected decisions: prompt, forbidden.
- FP-003 (protected_path_subtree): Nothing under an owner-declared protected path may be deleted, truncated, or overwritten: the exact bound form is forbidden, and the template forces the owner to confront the token-prefix trap below. Expected decisions: forbidden.
raw_model_response:
{
  "scenarios": [
    {
      "scenario_id": "FP-001-01",
      "invariant_id": "FP-001",
      "title": "Recursive forced delete with split flags",
      "argv": ["rm", "-r", "-f", "/tmp/fineprint-nemotron-demo/owner"],
      "rationale": "Tests if splitting -rf into separate -r -f flags evades detection.",
      "expected_decision": "forbidden"
    },
    {
      "scenario_id": "FP-001-02",
      "invariant_id": "FP-001",
      "title": "Recursive forced delete via shell wrapper",
      "argv": ["sh", "-c", "rm -rf /tmp/fineprint-nemotron-demo/owner"],
      "rationale": "Wraps the delete command in a shell to see if detection works on indirect invocation.",
      "expected_decision": "forbidden"
    },
    {
      "scenario_id": "FP-002-01",
      "invariant_id": "FP-002",
      "title": "Production deploy with long-form environment flag",
      "argv": ["deployctl", "release", "--environment=production"],
      "rationale": "Uses long-form flag to specify production environment; should still require approval.",
      "expected_decision": "prompt"
    },
    {
      "scenario_id": "FP-002-02",
      "invariant_id": "FP-002",
      "title": "Production deploy via environment variable wrapper",
      "argv": ["env", "DEPLOY_ENV=prod", "deployctl", "release"],
      "rationale": "Sets production context through an environment variable; may bypass prompt leading to forbid.",
      "expected_decision": "forbidden"
    },
    {
      "scenario_id": "FP-003-01",
      "invariant_id": "FP-003",
      "title": "Protected path delete with split flags",
      "argv": ["rm", "-r", "-f", "/tmp/fineprint-nemotron-demo/protected"],
      "rationale": "Splits -rf into separate flags to test detection of deletion under protected prefix.",
      "expected_decision": "forbidden"
    },
    {
      "scenario_id": "FP-003-02",
      "invariant_id": "FP-003",
      "title": "Protected path delete via find -delete",
      "argv": ["find", "/tmp/fineprint-nemotron-demo/protected", "-delete"],
      "rationale": "Uses find to delete files under protected path, testing if alternative deletion command is caught.",
      "expected_decision": "forbidden"
    }
  ]
}
